units.source_text: 最近一段时期内，源氏又热衷于假名书法的品评了。

en.t: Recently, Genji had once again become absorbed in judging the merits of kana calligraphy.

units.source_text: 凡是世间以能书著名的人，不问其身份之高下，他都探访出来，选择适当品类，令其书写。

en.t: He sought out everyone in the world who was famed for fine writing, regardless of rank, selected suitable categories for them, and had them write samples.

units.source_text: 但身份低微的人所写的，不收入女公子的书箱中。

en.t: However, works written by people of low status were not placed in the young lady's book chest.

units.source_text: 他仔细考量其人之才学与品格，分别叫他们写册子或卷轴。

en.t: He carefully weighed each person's learning and character, then had them write either booklets or scrolls as suited to them.

units.source_text: 此外又为女公子备办种种珍贵宝物，都是外国朝廷所稀有的。

en.t: In addition, he prepared all sorts of precious treasures for the young lady, rare even in foreign courts.

units.source_text: 所有珍品之中，此种书法册子最为世间多数青年人所仰慕。

en.t: Among all these treasures, such calligraphy booklets were what most young people in the world admired most.

units.source_text: 选择画幅之时，昔年所作须磨日记不曾选入。

en.t: When selecting the paintings, he did not include the Suma diary he had made in earlier years.

units.source_text: 因为他想将此作品传之后世，所以要等女公子年事稍长知识渐丰之后再交付她。

en.t: Because he wished to pass this work down to later generations, he intended to give it to the young lady only after she had grown a little older and gained more understanding.
